## Windows Rug v1.4.1

A fix for the living room not showing up.

### Fixes

- **Furniture not appearing.** The installer now copies the whole package, so no image folder can be left behind, and it stops with a clear message if anything is missing. If the furniture images are still missing when the rug starts, a notification tells you to run *Install.bat* again.
- **Reset room.** Right-click the rug → *Room* → *Reset room*, or use the tray icon. Every piece goes back to the bottom-right corner of the screen.
- **Furniture off-screen** (after unplugging a monitor or changing the resolution) is moved back on screen automatically.
- **Version in the tray.** Hover over the tray icon to see which version is running.

### Install

1. Download **WindowsRug.zip** below and extract it.
2. Open the extracted folder and double-click **Install.bat** inside it. It replaces any older version.
